pr.title: [Merged by Bors] - refactor(Order/Interval/Set/Basic): review some basic `Ixx` theorems
pr.body:
This PR does the following:

- Deprecate various lemmas of the form `x ∈ Ixx a b ↔ False` in favor of new lemmas `x ∉ Ixx a b`.
- Rename lemmas `left_mem_Ixi` and `right_mem_Iix` to simply `self_mem_Ixi` or `self_mem_Iix`.

---

Deletions:

- ...

Any other comments you want to keep out of the PR commit should go

If this PR depends on other PRs, please list them below this comment,
using the following format:

- [ ] depends on: #xyz [optional extra text]

I get what, say, `left_mem_Ici` is going for, but we generally reserve left/right for two-argument functions, and this is not one of them.
